Sources & image notes

The source dataset contains 21 distinct product references extracted from the supplied Amazon jewelry research workbook, across its opportunity and shortlist sheets. It is a curated research selection, not an independently verified Amazon Top 100 ranking.

Source snapshot: October 25, 2026. Reference prices were converted from Japanese yen using ¥150 = US$1. 18 selections with matched source images are displayed; 3 without verified source photos are skipped. One displayed selection has no price. References may differ from current prices, variants or availability. No reference price constitutes a FUBAO JEWELRY retail offer.

Each product page links to its original Amazon listing by ASIN. Product imagery is generated only from matched photos on those links, never from images embedded in the workbook. AI styling can alter fine detail; original listings remain the visual reference. Selections without verified photos are omitted from the displayed collection.

Homepage hero and lookbook imagery are editorial concepts, not photographs of catalog products. FUBAO JEWELRY is the site identity, not a claim to manufacture or own the referenced designs.

Material composition, dimensions, allergy suitability, durability and supplier availability require separate confirmation. Internal cost analysis and profit estimates are not published.

The saved list stays in your browser. This site takes no payments and creates no orders.
